mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d S&P 500 returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals broad-based consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 95.0), supply chain disruptions reduce industrial output and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts level indicates strong consumer confidence and construction activity, boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 5d S&P 500 returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI inflation exceeds 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 230), it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230, or Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 60d returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth and rise in unemployment signals rapidly deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation with low policy rates (CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%), the central bank is likely to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with low policy rates (CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%)
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or joint signal Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
